description: This source file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing module in the OpenClawKit project. It includes multiple test functions that verify the behavior of provider configuration selection, fallback mechanisms, dictionary bridging, and value resolution within the TalkConfigParsing logic.

methods.name: prefersCanonicalResolvedTalkProviderPayload
methods.description: Tests that the provider configuration correctly prioritizes a resolved payload with a provider and config.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Verifies that a normalized payload without a resolved field is rejected.

methods.name: fallsBackToLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Checks fallback to legacy fields when normalized payload data is missing.

methods.name: canDisableLegacyFallback
methods.description: Ensures that legacy fallback can be disabled explicitly.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenProviderMissingFromProviders
methods.description: Ensures rejection when provider info in payload does not match any known providers.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenMultipleProvidersAndNoProvider
methods.description: Verifies rejection when multiple providers exist but no provider is specified.

methods.name: bridgesFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Tests conversion of a standard dictionary to the internal representation used by the application.

methods.name: resolvesPositiveIntegerTimeout
methods.description: Verifies correct resolution of positive integer timeout values, including fallback behavior.
